name: Pyboard v1.0
notes: The micro-USB port talks to Thingstudio. The board's filesystem is mounted at /flash. The four onboard LEDs are on pins A13/A14/A15/B4 (LED_RED/LED_GREEN/LED_YELLOW/LED_BLUE), the same four pyb.LED(1-4) drives; the user switch SW is on X17 (PB3). X23/X24 don't exist on v1.0.
